integrity: Analytic proof and executable numerical checks are included. The source Gaussian-mixture formula and leading compact-support limit are credited to their original authors. No independent scientific audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive switching rates and distinct positive trap stiffnesses; stationary one-time maximum, fixed normalized threshold, N tending to infinity. No uniform parameter-crossover or pathwise assertion. Broad priority may be subsumed by general random-environment extreme-value theory.
title: Two logarithmic edge-leakage laws for maxima in a switching harmonic trap
